paragraphs: Mentioned in Pesachim 118a according to Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim; our reading is R' Shimon HaShiloni.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: ע״י and דק״ס are read contextually as Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim; the prefixed vav is translated once as and. The attributed Tzidoni/HaShiloni difference remains Hyman’s report, without fresh collation.
קיח. gives Pesachim 118a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification.
ר״ש is contextually Shimon from this notice, with title component R'. Of Sidon translates the heading epithet without an independent residence finding; the heading title also remains R'.
